basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast and part-time gamer from Seattle, WA. By day, I work as a software developer, focusing on creating intuitive user experiences. At night, you can find me immersed in the latest nuzlocke challenges or exploring the world of cryptocurrencies. I have a deep appreciation for music, especially vinyl records from artists like Taylor Swift. I enjoy discussing strategies for both gaming and investment, and I'm always up for a good debate. Currently single, I spend most evenings online, especially between 8 PM and midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science, which laid the foundation for my career in software development. My interest in cryptocurrencies developed through self-study and online courses. My gaming expertise, particularly in nuzlocke challenges, comes from years of playing and participating in online forums.
